### Mean
```{r}
## mean generator
log_mean_generator <- function(locs) {
  ## I want a function between -1 and 1
  return((2 * log((locs[, 1] + locs[, 2]) + 1) / log(3) - 1))
}
sin_mean_generator <- function(locs) {
  ## I want a function between -1 and 1
  return(sin(4 * pi * locs[, 1]) * sin(4 * pi * locs[, 2]) * exp(-8*((locs[, 1]-0.5)^2 + (locs[, 2]-0.5)^2)))
}

plot_eigenfunction(log_mean_generator(mesh$nodes()), mesh$nodes())
```


### Eigenfunctions
```{r}
#' The PC orthogonal functions used to generate the data are the eigenfunctions
#' of the laplacian operator with Neumann bdd conditions
laplacian_square_eigenfunction <- function(a, b, locs, x_t=0.2,y_t=0.2) {
  return(cos(a * pi * (locs[,1]-x_t)) * cos(b * pi * (locs[, 2]-y_t)))
}
f1_fem <- laplacian_square_eigenfunction(a = 1, b = 1, mesh$nodes())
f2_fem <- laplacian_square_eigenfunction(a = 2, b = 3, mesh$nodes())
f3_fem <- laplacian_square_eigenfunction(a = 4, b = 4, mesh$nodes())
test_functions <- cbind(f1_fem,f2_fem,f3_fem)

plot_eigenfunction(f1_fem, mesh$nodes())
plot_eigenfunction(f2_fem, mesh$nodes())
plot_eigenfunction(f3_fem, mesh$nodes())

```

```{r}
# Normalization and evaluation at locations
Vh <- FunctionSpace(mesh, fe_order=1)
u <- Function(Vh)
Lu <- -laplace(u) ## poisson problem
f <- function(points) { return(0*points[,1])}
pde <- Pde(Lu, f)
test_functions <- apply(test_functions, MARGIN=2, function(f,R0){ return(f/ sqrt(as.numeric(t(f) %*% R0 %*% f)))}, pde$mass())

#' Then the functions are evaluated at locations
locations <- unit_square.locs(n_locs,datadir)
Psi <- Vh$basis()$eval(as.matrix(locations))
test_functions.at_locs <- Psi %*% test_functions
```

```{r}
## missingness pattern
library(RANN)

# Optimized distance function
de <- function(x, y, w = 1) {
  res <- sum((x[1:2] - y[1:2])^2)
  if (length(x) == 3) {
    res <- res + w^2 * (x[3] - y[3])^2
  }
  sqrt(res)
}

# Optimized nearest neighbor function
nearest <- function(p, points, w = 1) {
  distances <- apply(points, 1, de, y = p, w = w)
  which.min(distances)
}

dep_space.NA_fast <- function(Data, 
                              p = 0.75, 
                              schema = "a", 
                              mesh_nodes = NULL, 
                              locations = NULL, 
                              RDD_groups = NULL) {
  if (schema == "c") {
    data_vector <- as.vector(Data)
    size <- length(data_vector)
    
    nodes <- mesh_nodes
    nobs <- ceiling(RDD_groups * p)
    pts <- locations
    
    # Use precomputed seeds if possible
    seeds <- nodes[sample(nrow(nodes), RDD_groups), , drop = FALSE]
    obs_marker <- rep(0, RDD_groups)
    obs_marker[sample(RDD_groups, nobs)] <- 1
    
    # Fast nearest neighbor search using RANN
    nn_results <- nn2(seeds, pts, k = 1)  # Finds nearest seed for each location
    nearest_idxs <- nn_results$nn.idx  # Index of the nearest seed
    
    # Vectorized NA assignment
    data_vector[obs_marker[nearest_idxs] == 0] <- NA
    
    Data <- matrix(data = data_vector, nrow = 1, ncol = size)
  }
  
  Data
}
```


## Utils
```{r}
align_cols <- function(to_be_aligned, reference){
  for(ii in 1:ncol(to_be_aligned)){
    dot_prod <- as.numeric(t(reference[,ii]) %*% to_be_aligned[,ii])
    if(dot_prod < 0) { to_be_aligned[,ii] <- (-1)*to_be_aligned[,ii]}
  }
  return(to_be_aligned)
}

wrapped_pca <- function(X, center = TRUE, n_comp = 3) {
  ## centering
  X_mean_locs <- rep(0, ncol(X))
  if(center) {
    X_mean_locs <- colMeans(X)
    X <- scale(X, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
  }
  # MV-PCA
  model_MV_PCA <- prcomp(X, center = FALSE, rank. = n_comp)

  ## results
  loadings_locs <- model_MV_PCA$rotation
  scores <- model_MV_PCA$x
  X_hat_locs <- scores %*% t(loadings_locs) + rep(1, nrow(scores)) %*% t(X_mean_locs)
  
  return(list(
    model = model_MV_PCA,
    results = list(
      loadings = NULL,
      loadings_locs = loadings_locs, #orthonormality w.r.t. MV product
      scores = scores,
      X_mean = NULL,
      X_mean_locs = X_mean_locs,
      X_hat = NULL,
      X_hat_locs = X_hat_locs
    )
  ))
}
```

Convention:

```{r}
# Flattening the results in convenient ways
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)

component_df <- NULL
# Step 1: Flatten component-level data with global info
component_df <- map_dfr(test_results, function(res) {
  global_info <- as_tibble(res$global)
  map_dfr(res$components, function(comp) {
    bind_cols(global_info, as_tibble(comp))
  })
})


final_results <- NULL
# Step 2: Pivot to wide format, creating one column per component metric
final_results <- component_df %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(replica, method, imputation_err, reconstruction_err, rank, centering),
    names_from = index,
    values_from = c(RMSE.PC, RMSE.Scores),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{index}"
  )
```

  errPC.plot <- ggplot(final_results, 
                       aes(x=method, 
                           y=get(paste("RMSE.PC_",i,sep="")), 
                           fill=factor(method, levels = c("fPCA-GCV","dineof")))) + 
    geom_boxplot() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map) +
    theme_light() +
    labs(y=paste("RMSE PC",i,sep=""),fill=NULL)  +
    theme(text = element_text(size=25), legend.position = "top") +
    guides(color="none", fill="none")  

  print(errPC.plot)
  
  if(save){
    ggsave(paste(plots_path,
               "/errPC",i,
             ".pdf", sep=""), 
       errPC.plot, width = 10, height = 5)
  }
}
